Record Class Lot

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
cascadia.board.Lot
Record Components:
typeToken - The fauna token type associated with this lot (e.g., FOX, BEAR).
typeHabitat - The habitat type of this lot (e.g., FOREST, RIVER, MOUNTAIN).
public record Lot(Optional<TuileHabitat> tile, Optional<TypeJetonFaune> typeToken) extends Record
Represents a lot consisting of a habitat type and a fauna token type. A lot is immutable and holds the necessary information for the habitat type and associated fauna token in the Cascadia game.

    • equals

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. All components in this record class are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object).
      Specified by:

      Parameters:

      Returns:
